```{r source-formulation}
#Source the pipeline (BaseMDP -> POMDP)
source("POMDPFormulation.R")
library(scales)

theme_paper <- theme(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
  text = element_text(size = 18),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
)
```

```{r compute-mismatch}
#Action mismatch rate: time-weighted fraction of trajectory where
#policy applies non-optimal action (500 trajectories, 20s each)
set.seed(42)

correct_map <- c("Nominal" = "NoAction", "SensorNoisy" = "DwSensorA",
                 "DynamicsOff" = "ReidentPlant", "Drift" = "BiasCorrect")
N_act <- 500
mismatch_df <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:N_act) {
  tr <- gillespie_pomdp(Q_rate, A, pomdp$Gamma, pomdp$actions, O_mat, c_rate, 1, 20, r_disc)
  sojourns <- diff(c(tr$times, 20))
  correct <- mapply(function(a, s) a == correct_map[states[s]], tr$actions, tr$states)
  mismatch_df <- rbind(mismatch_df, data.frame(
    policy = "POMDP (PBVI)", mismatch_time = sum(sojourns[!correct]) / 20))

  tr_m <- gillespie_mcda(Q_rate, mcda_ideal_action, O_mat, mcda_dwell_time, c_rate, 1, 20, r_disc)
  sojourns_m <- diff(c(tr_m$times, 20))
  correct_m <- mapply(function(a, s) a == correct_map[states[s]], tr_m$actions, tr_m$states)
  mismatch_df <- rbind(mismatch_df, data.frame(
    policy = "MCDA (TOPSIS)", mismatch_time = sum(sojourns_m[!correct_m]) / 20))
}

mismatch_summary <- aggregate(mismatch_time ~ policy, data = mismatch_df,
                               FUN = function(x) c(mean = mean(x), se = sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))))
mismatch_summary <- do.call(data.frame, mismatch_summary)
colnames(mismatch_summary) <- c("policy", "mean_mismatch", "se")

print(paste0("POMDP mismatch: ", round(mismatch_summary$mean_mismatch[mismatch_summary$policy == "POMDP (PBVI)"] * 100, 1), "%"))
print(paste0("MCDA mismatch: ", round(mismatch_summary$mean_mismatch[mismatch_summary$policy == "MCDA (TOPSIS)"] * 100, 1), "%"))
```

```{r plot-figure6, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
pal_mismatch <- c("POMDP (PBVI)" = "#574964", "MCDA (TOPSIS)" = "#5A7863")

ggplot(mismatch_summary, aes(x = policy, y = mean_mismatch, fill = policy)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_mismatch - 1.96 * se,
                    ymax = mean_mismatch + 1.96 * se), width = 0.12) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(mean_mismatch * 100, 1), "%")),
            vjust = -0.8, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_mismatch) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent,
                     limits = c(0, max(mismatch_summary$mean_mismatch) * 1.3)) +
  labs(title = "Action Mismatch Rate: POMDP vs MCDA",
       x = NULL, y = "Mismatch Rate") +
  theme_paper + theme(legend.position = "none")
```
